sql.schedule.getEvents: with start_time as ( select ppscfv.id, ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id, ppscfv.project_process_step_id, ppscfv.timestamp_value from flow.project_process_step_custom_field_value ppscfv inner join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on cfga.id = ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id where cfga.schedule_field_type_id = 1 ), end_time as ( select ppscfv.id, ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id, ppscfv.project_process_step_id, ppscfv.timestamp_value from flow.project_process_step_custom_field_value ppscfv inner join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on cfga.id = ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id where cfga.schedule_field_type_id = 2 ), resource as ( select ppscfv.id, ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id, ppscfv.project_process_step_id, ppscfv.int_value from flow.project_process_step_custom_field_value ppscfv inner join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on cfga.id = ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id where cfga.schedule_field_type_id = 3 ) select cfg.group_name, cfg.schedule_color, pps.process_step_id, pps.project_id, pps.id as project_process_step_id, sl.system_list_type_id, st.timestamp_value as start, et.timestamp_value as end, r.int_value as resource_id, case when sl.system_list_type_id = 1 then o.org_name else u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name end as resource_name from flow.custom_field_group cfg inner join flow.project_process_step pps on pps.process_step_id = cfg.process_step_id left join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga1 on cfga1.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id and cfga1.schedule_field_type_id = 1 left join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga2 on cfga2.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id and cfga2.schedule_field_type_id = 2 left join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga3 on cfga3.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id and cfga3.schedule_field_type_id = 3 left join start_time st on st.project_process_step_id = pps.id and st.custom_field_group_assignment_id = cfga1.id left join end_time et on et.project_process_step_id = pps.id and et.custom_field_group_assignment_id = cfga2.id left join resource r on r.project_process_step_id = pps.id and r.custom_field_group_assignment_id = cfga3.id left join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga3.custom_field_id left join flow.user u on u.id = r.int_value left join flow.org o on o.id = r.int_value left join flow.company_system_list csl on csl.id = cf.company_system_list_id left join flow.system_list sl on sl.id = csl.system_list_id where cfg.schedulable is true and cfg.archived is not true and st.timestamp_value is not null and et.timestamp_value is not null and r.int_value is not null and case when :startTime::date is not null then st.timestamp_value >= :startTime::date else 1=1 end and case when :endTime::date is not null then et.timestamp_value <= :endTime::date else 1=1 end and ( case when array_length(ARRAY[ :orgIds ]::INTEGER[], 1) > 0 then ARRAY[o.id] <@ ARRAY[ :orgIds ]::INTEGER[] end OR case when array_length(ARRAY [ :userIds ]::BIGINT[], 1) > 0 then ARRAY [u.id] <@ ARRAY [ :userIds ]::BIGINT[] end )
